items.exampleEn: We have received numerous emails about the new rule.
items.exampleZh: 我們收到很多關於新規定的郵件。

items.exampleEn: The final game was intense from start to finish.
items.exampleZh: 決賽從頭到尾都很激烈。

items.exampleEn: The trip takes approximately three hours.
items.exampleZh: 這趟旅程大約要三個小時。

items.exampleEn: Share the money equally between the two of you.
She received a substantial pay rise this year.
The depth of the pool is two meters.
She had a minor role in the movie.
items.exampleZh: 她在那部電影裡演一個小角色。

items.sentenceEn: There were numerous people waiting outside the shop.

items.audioEn: The meeting will last approximately two hours, so let's start on time.
items.audioZh: 會議大約會開兩個小時，所以我們準時開始吧。

items.sentenceEn: Both answers are equally good, so I can't choose.
items.sentenceZh: 兩個答案一樣好，所以我沒辦法選。

items.sentenceEn: The competition between the two shops is intense.
items.sentenceZh: 這兩家店之間的競爭很激烈。

items.stemEn: The changes to the report are only ____, so it won't take long.
items.stemZh: 報告要改的地方都只是小地方，所以不會花太久。

items.stemEn: The company had a ____ increase in sales this year; sales nearly doubled.
items.stemZh: 公司今年的銷售額大幅成長，幾乎翻了一倍。

items.passageEn: Last summer, our town had extreme weather. For approximately two weeks, the heat was intense, and numerous people stayed indoors. The town's lake lost a substantial amount of water, and its depth dropped by almost one meter. Luckily, the other problems were minor: only a few old trees died. The town now asks everyone to save water and to share it fairly with the farms.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我們鎮上遇到極端的天氣。大約有兩個星期，熱得非常厲害，很多人都待在室內。鎮上的湖少了大量的水，深度降了將近一公尺。幸好其他問題都不嚴重：只有幾棵老樹死了。鎮公所現在請大家節約用水，並和農場公平地分享用水。

questions.questionZh: 那次高溫大約持續多久？
鎮上的湖發生了什麼事？
options: 湖裡的水一下子完全乾了
湖水變得很髒，不能游泳

items.promptZh: 這次旅行大約花了五百美元。
referenceEn: The trip cost approximately five hundred dollars.
This trip cost about five hundred dollars.
rubricZh: approximately 表示「大約」，放在數字前
過去的事用過去式（cost 的過去式也是 cost）
寫 about、around 意思也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 minor 造一個句子，說說你最近遇到的一個小問題。
referenceEn: I had a minor problem with my computer yesterday.
There was a minor mistake in my report last week.
rubricZh: minor 表示「較小的、不嚴重的」，放在名詞前（例如 a minor problem）
過去的事可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 had、was、have had）
說的是自己遇到的事（例如 I、my）
